name: Chronic periodontal infection
overview: A chronic bacterial infection of the periodontium leading to gingival inflammation, pocketing, and possible bone loss. Often associated with poor oral hygiene, smoking, diabetes, or immunosuppression.
labs_key: CRP may be mildly elevated in acute flares
WBC usually normal unless systemic involvement
red_flags: Facial swelling or trismus (consider deep space infection)
Systemic toxicity, fever, dysphagia (consider Ludwig’s angina)

name: Iron deficiency anemia
overview: Microcytic anemia caused by insufficient iron. In adults, most commonly due to blood loss; in children, dietary deficiency. Treat cause + replenish iron.
labs_key: Low Ferritin, low Transferrin saturation, elevated TIBC
red_flags: Unexplained anemia in men/post-menopausal women (evaluate GI tract)

name: Viral upper respiratory infection
overview: Self-limited viral infection of the upper airway (rhinovirus, coronavirus, etc.). Symptomatic care; antibiotics not indicated.
labs_key: CRP/WBC often normal or mildly elevated

name: Type 2 diabetes mellitus
overview: Chronic hyperglycemia from insulin resistance ± relative insulin deficiency. Lifestyle + pharmacotherapy; screen for complications.
labs_key: FPG ≥7.0 mmol/L or A1C ≥6.5% (on repeat/confirmatory testing)

name: Acute myocardial infarction
overview: Acute ischemic myocardial necrosis. Time-critical: MONA, ECG, troponin, reperfusion (PCI).

references.title: Heart & Stroke Foundation of Canada – ACS
